::: {#exr-reversed-text-information}
#### Which guessing game is harder?

Use @exr-reversed-text-total-entropy, @exr-forward-n-gram-conditional-entropy and @exr-backward-n-gram-conditional-entropy
to compare the information per character in a reversed text and in the text read forward,
and use that comparison to explain the difference in difficulty described in @rem-reversed-text-guessing.

:::
